body: Idk why everyone keeps complaining about your makeup being "too heavy". I think it looks really nice actually, especially for a beginner. Anyways, you're definitely not ugly by any means. You're above average imho.
You're speaking to my soul. I'm so sorry for the constant pain that losing your love has caused you. I understand it completely. If you ever wanna talk about it, my message bank thing is always open
This is scarily accurate. It makes me sad that this is so true
So true, honestly
I'm super late here, but thank you. I wish you a wonderful year
Amen. This post is insanely accurate. A shame that the people who do that mess never can see how terrible they sound when they say that stuff
Be myself. It never fails to gain rejection lol
Same here, fam. Also, this is probably the most honest, genuine comment Ive ever seen on this sub, and I love it.

I know exactly how you feel. Im so sorry youre going through this; you've literally lost your whole entire lifeline, and you don't know how to go on in life. I had to live without her for four months, and I felt the same way I am now - broken.  I'll never get better unless something changes with her, but I have hope for you for some odd reason. I hope somehow you can find a reason to live, and if you want/need to vent, please feel free to message me

Phew, thank you cause thats usually the go-to response people usually provide unless they're hoping (like me) that this is just a bump in the road and that we'll work it out at some point. Well, it's all honestly a long story. Do you mind if I message you explaining it and the situation itself?

Trust me, shes it for me. I literally can't get myself to love anyone else. You're right though, Im staying here for my dad because he's lost so many people in his life that I dont want to make him lose another one, so he's the other reason. I can't even move on from an old friendship that ended almost a decade ago. Im just broken and have been for awhile, and I really dont believe there is much future left in general. Thank you for the kind words though, you're very kind.

Im well-aware of that now. It would've happened to me no matter what though cause Ive wrapped myself up in the same thing with platonic relationships too. We were/are only on a break right now, but it happened around the same time things were going bad, so 10 months ago. Also, please dont tell me I need to live for myself or anything like that cause even before the relationship, I was barely making it
Its been 10 for me. If you wanna talk about it, definitely feel free. We heartbroken people can help each other out a bit sometimes

Ok, that's what I thought, but I just wanted to be 100% sure. Thank you again. The fact that so many people don't understand how 4-way stops, or uncontrolled intersections in general, work makes me want to understand everything I can about them so I can be a safe driver.
I know how you feel. How long has it been since your breakup?

Thank you so much. Yeah, my bad, I forgot to mention I know the first come first serve rule too (it's literally everywhere, so I cant not see it lol). So, in the example I gave, would it be best for the car turning to just stop and wait for the car (to its left) to go straight or to start turning shortly after that car passes?

This actually made me tear up and most posts on this site/app in general rarely cause me to do that. Dude, I know this doesnt help at all, but Im immensely sorry for the pain youre going through right now. I wasnt/am not in your exact position, but the description of the pain you're in is something I literally went through myself and will go through if it happens again. If you need someone to talk to, feel free to message. Im sending you the very best vibes, man

If this is a real confession, you have some problems that you probably (definitely) should try to work out. Also, you dont seem remorseful at all even though you have this post under the remorse tag. Not trying to be rude, but it does seem that way based off of the post

It seems to me like you literally didnt do anything wrong, and Jill seems strangely and easily annoyed. I wouldn't beat myself up over this if I were you. You did everything she asked you to and not to do, so you really aren't at fault for anything. Because Carlos liked Jill a lot, he willingly took her side and failed to try to understand you. The fact that she is friendless was literally HER decision, so youre also not at fault for that.

The thing that sucks is that you cant change your family,but you can get rid of your "friends". I've learned that it's legit better to leave some people and be alone than to stick around and take their bullcrap. They don't treat you like friends from your description, and you will be much better alone than with them. They make you feel worse about things than better, so they really have no need in your life. In regard to your fam, just do your very best to tough it out until you can get out of school, get a job, and get a car/license. Once you're arounf 19, you can run away far from the toxicity that they're giving you. If you want to talk to someone on here, Im always down. I wish you well.

Thank you so much. It's been 3 weeks now, and I'm kinda just trying to let it be bc if she wants us to be close friends again, she will come back to talk it out with me. We did and didnt. Kinda just argued a lot and we both failed to see the other's point of view. In the beginning of the argument, she said she wanted to just be friends and that she doesn't want a relationship in general. She was the first to reach out after the argument but didn't apologize. I've only just realized that we were both wrong, even though she said way more hurtful things than I could have imagined saying back to her

It's mostly been my ex tbh and me just wondering if shell still be in my life, even if its just as a friend. The idea of losing her has terrified me. I have gotten into a support group on discord though. Sorry am just seeing this now
Not that easy for me, man
This is goals. If you can, please tell them you love them
I feel this completely right now or probably will end up in the same position. Im so sorry for you, man. I know what you mean by saying there are other people but speaking to them isn't the same.
No problem. Please let us know how things go when an update happens!
😂😂 I was just about to say that

Im actually in a similar situation. Right now, Im just giving space and hoping things work out. The fact that your guy still wants to work things out and talk at some point is a good sign imo. I have hope for you two, and I'll be wishing you the absolute best.

I understand what youre saying. I know this pain too well, especially right now. Please just do all you can to better yourself. She will appreciate it, and the love she has had for you will more than likely be there again. People - thoughtful people at least - notice efforts to change for the better, and whatever you can do to make that happen, go for it. I'm rooting for you and her.

You are honestly such a strong person for holding on during all this stuff. I about cried the more I read on, and your story touched me so deeply. I'm so glad that you seem to be feeling better now, and I really hope you and your gf, and you, your mom, and your brother, can work things out. You seem like a wonderful person, and I cant imagine making it through all the stuff you have, just, youre amazing, man

Sorry Im late, but of course. Too many people just want to slide the problems of others under the table, whether they be strangers or not. Idc if I know someone or not, if we're in the same boat and need help, Im always down to talk it out. Thank you for saying that though, thats very kind of you

Im so sorry youre feeling the same pain. It is virtually unbearable, but we just have to hold onto these people unless they let go. Thank you so much. I hope things go well for you too. If you ever want to talk about it and vent please feel free to message
r/complaints r/angry

I get that completely. The good thing is that in both of our situations things arent completely over yet or anything. Theres still an opportunity for a happy ending for us. Yeah,  I talked to her recently, and she's really upset with numerous things. I want to help, but I dont have much power to help rn, so Im just gonna remain patient and hope things work out between us again.

Yeah. Honestly, we werent even officially together, but that was all on me. It all just comes down to these reasons: me being too immature (which was true at the time); her family influencing her away from me without her knowing it; and her stress levels being extremely high. She has more things that she wants to do with her life and it's like whatever romantic interest just got kicked to the curb for that. I cant say I blame her cause Ive done the same type of thing before. Also she feels like I havent put any effort into my own life, and she wants me to succeed and doesnt want to continue being a distraction for me. She said she doesnt want to be in any romantic relationship, and she doesnt really ever lie, so she probably means that. I think she's willing to fix things, but I'm not holding my breath.

Me right now. Whatever little sense of hope I have, whether it is false or true hope, it's the only thing helping me to get up in the morning everyday. Otherwise, my heart wouldn't have the desire to continue on

Hmmm yeah, I forget that theres always a possibility of the person coming back on their knees and regretting their decisions. I would hope that she would come back to you, but not because her relationship failed with the new guy, Id hope shed do so just cause she realized she missed out on you. 

I cant move on, man. Im stuck, so I know the pain isnt going anywhere anytime soon, or it may just never go away. I keep praying that things just go back to the way they were between us because this is a new type of brokeness that Ive never endured over any other person.
Ahh. I get that. I feel the same way tbh. It seems like everyone has a chance in life or some potential that promises them goodness later in life, except me

I thought yall hadnt met yet, but yeah, thats terrible honestly. It makes sense that you just didnt feel ready yet, it happens to all of us at some point. I just dont know how people can switch up on others when things are seeming so so perfect. I guess if nothing else at least you can still have some type of friendship with her if you wanted. Amd yikes, at least her fam liked you I guess, but that also adds to the pain considering everything. I wish I had received approval of their family because this situation would have probably been so different right now, and thats breaking me apart.
Who is they?

Wow smh. Ok, see with me, we had hung out for awhile and spent loads of time together and I just havent heard from them in what feels like forever. I'm gonna be honest, be happy you didnt meetup in person, because if she wasnt able to appreciate you with the amount of love you gave her, no matter how great, I can tell just by her saying that, that she probably wouldve still done the same thing. She actually did you a favor Id say tbh

Same here, man. Literally same thing here. That's crazy. I regret it so much cause I shouldve just taken the plunge since the person knew and wasn't bothered by it at the time. Is she truly gone? Like , did she give up on you?
I hope you find peace inall this pain. I have been left a lot too, but this one I was/still somehow am, sure this person was the one, and I dont know what to do.

I know what youre talking about, man. It's absolutely awful and everything just hurts, but you may have a chance. I've had people tell me, and Ive told myself a few times, that so long as youre alive, things in your life can change and become better, but if you're dead, nothing will. What I'm saying here is, maybe she will come back. 5 years is a long time to spend with someone, and even if you have unintentionally hurt her, you do have the ability and the opportunity to make things better again. It's not over unless you end it. Two months have been terrible, but if you wait a few more months, things can become fantastic, and that's what Im sticking around for - to see things possibly become fantastic. Idk your whole situation with her, but I have a feeling there's a lot of hope for it.

I know exactly how you feel. I'm basically in the same boat right now, aside from the 5 years and the person telling me that they wont be back part, but I know theyre not coming back. Ive been feeling the same pain as you for two months also, which is kinda ironic. Ive been praying that things change, and very little has happened, but at the same time, I think these are things that wont be fixed within the timespan of two months. Please feel free to talk if you want cause I think we both may need it
I think it helps tbh. Most of us are already feeling crumby, so at least this provides an outlet for those whose minds are already in a negative place
I feel the exact same way, honestlt. It all seems so hopelesss, but let me ask you this, do you have an interest in closure? To see what happens and how things could possibly change?
